name: Foldspace Spiral
introDiscord:
The path spirals inward.

Then keeps spiraling inward.

The inside somehow becomes larger than the outside.
introTwitch:
The path spirals inward.

Then keeps spiraling inward.

The inside somehow becomes larger than the outside.

foldspace-spiral-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Foldspace Spiral.

left.message:
A Foldspace Nautilus retreats into its shell and reappears fifty feet
away without crossing the distance.

right.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's sign:

'Entered small shell.

Shell contained hallway.

Hallway contained room.

Room contained larger shell.

Leaving.'

forward.message: A coffer sits inside a pocket larger than the rock containing it.

foldspace-spiral-depths.prompt: Deeper within Foldspace Spiral, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: A tiny chamber opens into an enormous peaceful cavern.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Nautilus attacks from the interior of its own shell.

forward.message: Star Candies spiral through folded space.

foldspace-spiral-threshold.prompt: Near Room Within Its Shell, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A cache is larger inside than the entire corridor outside.

right.message: A restorative chamber fits impossibly inside a shell fragment.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Foldspace Nautilus unfolds an entire room around you.

bossPromptDiscord:
Room Within Its Shell opens.

Then another room opens inside that.

Then another.

Something enormous occupies ALL of them.

Use /yes to enter or /no to reject spatial nesting.
bossPromptTwitch:
Room Within Its Shell opens.

Then another room opens inside that.

Then another.

Something enormous occupies ALL of them.

Use !yes to enter or !no to reject spatial nesting.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Room Within Its Shell. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The innermost shell opens into impossible distance.

Infinite-Chamber Nautilus reveals itself!

completionText:
The shell closes.

It now fits comfortably in your palm.

Absolutely unacceptable.
